records.subject: ATaO3 perovskite oxides (A = Rb, Fr)

In addition, PBE plus Tran and Blaha modified Becke-Johnson (PBE + TB-mBJ) functional have been utilized to improve the electronic properties.
These compounds belong to the semiconductor category, which include contributions of Rb-d, Fr-d/f, Ta-d and O-2p orbitals to explore their behavior.
